case_number: Civil Appeal No. 2471 of 2023 (@ SLP (C) No. 6185/2020)

parties.petitioner: The Director (Admn. and HR) KPTCL & Ors.

summary: Increment entitlement on retirement; Regulation 40(1) of Karnataka Electricity Board Employees Service Regulations, 1997; accrual vs. entitlement; divergence in High Court decisions; increment earned for past service, not incentive; retirement day entitlement sustained; impugned High Court judgment upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Karnataka Electricity Board Employees Service Regulations, 1997 Regulation 40(1)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment directing grant of annual increment upheld.
